provenance: Actual Electron renderer from out/renderer of the checkout this script ran in; synthetic services; report figures computed by src/shared/attempts.ts; no real agent calls
checks: Runs opens on headless runs as before, with a switch to Attempts beside New run
best of N compares each attempt by gate, files, cost, duration and oracle flags; the unreported cost reads "not reported", no $0.00 appears, and removal waits for a kept attempt
Keep records one decision; the cleanup lists the other worktrees before removing, and reports the one it kept for uncommitted work beside the one it removed
the bench reports n, passes, pass@1, pass@k and pass^k with the form named, cost per solved task with n of K reported, and an arm with no passes as measured zeros with no cost figure
the evidence label and the lead each carry their reason in words: correlation because one gate could not run, and a lead of 2 over 3 named past √3
the start form states the ceiling in words, names the arm whose CLI takes no budget flag, refuses a zero budget by naming the ceiling, and puts Start behind a confirmation
confirming sends one start with the planned arms, repeats, budget and timeout, and a refusal from main is shown as an error
a failed read of the set list renders as a failure with the error and a retry, never as an empty list
a failed read of one set renders as a failure naming what is untouched, never as a set with no attempts
